sources.title: GitHub - LanguageJunction/healthcare-pathways-slm: A small medical ...
sources.snippet: A small medical-language model built with a decoder-only Transformer and a Pathways-inspired Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer. This project is intended for learning, experimentation, and research in low-resource medical text generation.
